observed: WebKit image-PDF streaming rejected the first image with an invalid queue order. The same DOM handshake test passed in Chromium.
diagnosis: A lazy PDF module imported the side-effectful Worker entry. Re-entering that module resets its stream state; avoiding that circular dependency is necessary regardless of engine module caching behavior.
change: Specialize PDF Blob creation inside the PDF module to keep its dependency graph independent of the Worker entry. The bytes and MIME remain unchanged.
